Authored QA fixture. The embedded page is the real API playground, not a simulated viewer. Load failure / retry fixture
Interaction and mobile checks
  1. Open Example source. Scroll NOVA to Design / Sound / Compare / Configure. Wait for the real bot speech. The matching authored section and presentation lines highlight.
  2. Switch to Shop. Save a more expensive item with ♡; browse a cheaper same-category item. Source highlights only when the real recommendation speaks.
  3. Switch to Community. Scroll to receive a local new post; publish locally to receive a mention. Arrival source highlights when it is actually inserted.
  4. Reset or switch while a recommendation is moving. Old source highlights must disappear. Try all four locales.
  5. Wheel/touch/keyboard-read code: follow turns off. Enable follow to jump back. Tab keys, arrow-key file tabs, Copy file, collapse/reopen all work without interrupting the example.
  6. At 390px width the source is a nonmodal disclosure below the still-interactive iframe. At 1280px it is beside the iframe. No horizontal page overflow, focus theft or motion when reduced-motion is enabled.
